subject: The plate seen face on as a square field of junction cells, each lit by how far it swings, clamped in a hatched section frame and keyed with patent numerals.
controls: size: count, the field steps from 4 x 4 to 12 x 12 junction cells (16 to 144) and the clamp frame grows with it.
tension: shape of the lit pattern (palette swaps across the field), broad lobes at 0 breaking into a finer, stretched checker of nodal lines at 100.
damp: position, the felt band's inner line moves in from the clamp toward the centre and the cells under it go hollow.
pickup: position, the bright outlined pickup cell (numeral 14) walks from the strike point at 0 to the far corner at 100.
reference: opxy/reference/README.md (dissolve, in detail; stock cell field) and library/toro-blocks
risks: P15 is written for noise-like sounds with no mechanism, and this plate has one (Gate 0 pitfall in P15): the cell field is earned only because the waveguide mesh really is a grid of junctions. Tension and damp both act on cell values; damp is kept on geometry (felt line) so the two don't share 'how much grey'. 14 px cells are under P15's 20 px guidance (12 x 12 has to fit 192 px of body); 144 cells + frame fits 256 nodes but tension re-lights many cells per turn, so churn needs a cap. Patent numerals plus words duplicates the key; drop one at frames.
